name: Piramal Aranya
address: E.S. Patanwala Marg, behind Rani Baug (Byculla Zoo), Byculla East, Mumbai 400027
amenities: About 2 lakh sq ft of amenity space with 40+ amenities
Podium: viewing terrace, yoga lawn, lap pool, events lawn, kids' zone, outdoor cafe/barbeque, outdoor gym, dog park, jacuzzi
Recreation ground: multipurpose court, cricket field, rock climbing, lap pool, kids' pool, amphitheatre, walking track
Clubhouse: badminton, squash, golf simulator, theatre, library, indoor games, spa treatment rooms, salon, creche, fitness centre
Tower-level fitness centre, library/reading lounge and rooftop observation deck
description: A three-tower luxury development on about 7 acres beside Rani Baug (Jijamata Udyan, Byculla Zoo), with views of the 60-acre botanical garden to the west and Mumbai Harbour to the east. Avyan and the 72-storey Arav have been delivered; Ahan has two wings, Ahan I (OC received) and Ahan II (launched July 2025, topped out). The March 2016 launch offered large 3 and 4 BHK residences at Rs 8-12 crore; later towers moved to smaller 2 and 3 BHK homes from about Rs 2.6-2.75 crore.
notes: Phases: Avyan (Wing A, P51900003324), Arav (Wing B, P51900018039, 72 storeys), Ahan I (Wing C, P51900020330) and Ahan II (P51900051735). Piramal's site describes the project as 41 to 72 storeys and mortgaged to ICICI Bank. The 2016 launch release said 'approximately 70-storey', 3.7 million sq ft of construction and a Rs 4,300 crore investment; the Aug 2016 release said Rs 4,450 crore incl. land. Track2Realty's Oct 2018 headline called it a Rs 7,500 crore project. Product shift: the 2016 launch sold 1,700-2,600 sq ft carpet 3/4 BHKs at about Rs 46,000-47,000/sq ft carpet, while Arav (2018) and Ahan (2020) were 2/3 BHKs from 613-763 sq ft, so later per-sq-ft figures compare different products. Delivery: Piramal says 700+ homes were delivered in Avyan and Arav by Jul 2025, and that Avyan got its OC 21 months ahead of schedule (no date given). Piramal Realty announced OCs for Aranya, Vaikunth and Revanta on 11 May 2023 (tower not specified). Sales: Square Yards says 212 of 337 launched Ahan II units were booked by Nov 2025 (another entry on the same page says 36 of 292, so treat as uncertain). Total units are not confirmed: Square Yards gives 480 for Arav and 641 for Ahan. Price conflict: Housing.com shows the project's average price per sq ft falling about 6.7% (and Wing B about 8.7%) over a year to 2025, while Square Yards asking prices were roughly flat at Rs 48,000-49,000 in 2026. Land area: official 7 acres; Square Yards says 7.63 acres. Distances: the 2016 release put BKC at 11.4 km and the domestic airport at 16 km; Piramal's current site gives the international airport (T2) as about 17.3 km and Atal Setu about 3 km.
architect: Make Architects (UK); interiors Hirsch Bedner Associates; structure/MEP BuroHappold; landscape EDSA
contractor: Larsen & Toubro (core and shell civil works, contract over Rs 700 crore, awarded Aug 2016)

news.title: Piramal Realty launches its signature project Piramal Aranya at Byculla
news.summary: Launch of a 7-acre, roughly 70-storey development with 1,700-2,600 sq ft carpet 3/4 BHKs at Rs 8-12 crore, via an EOI pre-launch with a Rs 10 lakh token.

news.title: Piramal Realty inks milestone partnership with L&T Construction; launches exclusive inventory of elite harbour facing suites
news.summary: L&T wins the core-and-shell contract worth over Rs 700 crore; new 3 BHK harbour-facing suites of 1,258-1,272 sq ft carpet; project investment put at Rs 4,450 crore incl. land.

news.title: Piramal Realty launches INR 7500 crore project in Byculla
news.summary: Launch of Arav, the second tower: more than 300 units of 2/3 BHK, 763 to about 1,400 sq ft carpet, from Rs 2.75 crore.

news.title: Piramal Realty launches "Ahan" at Piramal Aranya
news.summary: Third tower, Ahan, launched with 2 and 3 bed homes from Rs 2.59 crore (per search snippets; article blocked).

news.title: Piramal Realty receives Occupancy Certificate (OC) for three luxury projects in MMR
news.summary: Piramal announces OCs for Aranya (Byculla), Vaikunth (Thane) and Revanta (Mulund). Which Aranya tower is not stated in the coverage found; article body not retrieved.

news.title: Piramal Realty Launches Ahan II In An Ecosystem & A Community In Full Bloom At Piramal Aranya In Rani Baug, Byculla
news.summary: Final phase, Ahan II (2, 3 and 4 bed), launched; over 700 homes already delivered in Avyan and Arav.
